en.t: The young buds of the trees were the same.

units.source_text: 枫树和扇骨木嫩芽的红、柿树嫩芽的绿……

en.t: The red of the young maple and fan-bone tree buds, the green of the young persimmon buds...

units.source_text: 对他来说，就像初生婴儿的颜色，是一个奇迹。

en.t: To him, they were like the colors of a newborn baby, a miracle.

units.source_text: 五天当中总有一天，山野的林木一旦变成色彩缤纷的喷泉或阳伞，他也就不再赏景了。

en.t: One day out of every five, once the trees of the mountains and fields turned into fountains or parasols of many colors, he no longer admired the scenery.
